lines.en: I raise myself from beneath the sea.
Eight arms row beneath me.

lines.zh: 水被我搅成白色的泡沫。
lines.en: The water churns white around me.

lines.zh: 我往前一探，浪就起来了。
lines.en: One lunge and the waves rise.
I move across the surface, slowly.

lines.zh: 我往前一探，天空开始暗。
lines.en: One lunge, and the sky darkens.

lines.zh: 我的腕足缠住一块礁石。
lines.en: An arm coils around a rock.
One coil of my arm, and the rock crumbles.

lines.zh: 海面被我推起一道长浪。
lines.en: My moving shoves a long swell across the surface.
The seabirds have all fled.
I float on the surface, rising and falling.
My eyes are large and black.
Water slides off me.
Storm clouds press down and the sea darkens.
I turn my arms slowly.
A fish swims beneath me.
A fish swims beneath. I don't move.
I don't move. The sea is flat.

lines.zh: 腕足抬到半途，慢慢又落回海中。
lines.en: An arm rises halfway, then sinks back.
I lift an arm and water sheets off.
Floating, I wait.
My breathing makes the waves bigger.

lines.zh: 我在这一片海待了很久。
lines.en: I've been in this sea a long time.
Long enough for the rocks to change shape.

lines.zh: 我把身子没入水中半截。
lines.en: I sink half my body beneath the water.
Then rise again.
I lean down toward you on the shore.

lines.zh: 从这高度看你，小得可笑。
lines.en: From up here, you're absurdly small.
But you came anyway.
I raise an arm.
Water pours off it.
I set it on the shore.

lines.zh: 我把腕足放在岸上，你退了。
lines.en: I set an arm on the shore. You back away.
You backed away. Yes. You should.
This sea is mine.

lines.zh: 潮水会替我把你带回来。
lines.en: The tide will bring you back to me.

lines.zh: 这一片海归我，用不着着急。
lines.en: This sea is mine. No need to rush.
I retract the arm slowly.
My arm recoils.
My arm recoils. I sink back.
A gash opens in my hide.

lines.zh: 厚皮裂开一道口子，我没出声。
lines.en: A gash opens in my hide. I stay silent.

lines.zh: 海水里漂开我自己的血。
lines.en: My own blood clouds the sea.

lines.zh: 我沉下几尺，让海水盖住伤口。
lines.en: I sink a few fathoms and let the sea cover the wound.

lines.zh: 我转身时，整片海都跟着动。
lines.en: When I turn, the whole sea turns with me.

lines.zh: 海水里混进我的血，你打中了。
lines.en: My blood mixes in. You hit me.
You actually hit me. Rare.

lines.zh: 这种事不常有，我记下了。
lines.en: That's unusual. I'll remember it.
Whatever you brought is too small.

lines.zh: 我一口就能吞下整条船。
lines.en: I could swallow a whole boat in one go.

lines.zh: 你举起东西，你的手在抖。
lines.en: You hold it up. Your hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 你手抖得厉害，再举高些。
lines.en: Your hands shake. Higher.
Higher. I can't see it.
Can't see it. I lower my head.
Lowered, and still nothing.
Still nothing. I raise an arm.

lines.zh: 我一条腕足高高扬起，你脚别挪。
lines.en: An arm rears high. Keep your feet still.
Don't back away. Never mind.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，滑进水里。
lines.en: You hit me and slide into the water.

lines.zh: 我伸出一条腕足，横拦过去。
lines.en: I put an arm across your path.

lines.zh: 腕足横拦，海水炸成白沫。
lines.en: The arm blocks, and the sea bursts white.
You're washed back onto the shore.

lines.zh: 你被浪推回岸，我其实没使劲。
lines.en: Washed back ashore, and I barely pushed.

lines.zh: 我没有用力，海面又平了。
lines.en: I wasn't trying. The sea flattens.

lines.zh: 海面复归平静，我俯视你。
lines.en: The surface smooths. I look down at you.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，胸口还在起伏。
lines.en: I look down. Your chest is still heaving.
Still breathing. Good.
Next time the tide will be higher.
A kin's low call from the deep.
The sound is very, very far.

lines.zh: 我低鸣一声，深海那头静了。
lines.en: I give a low call; the deep falls silent.
The surface shudders.

lines.zh: 我应了它一声，它并不浮上来。
lines.en: I answer it. It doesn't surface.
I don't go down.
An entire sea lies between us.

lines.zh: 我同样没潜下去，这样也好。
lines.en: Nor do I dive. That's fine.

lines.zh: 这样也很好，我继续浮着。
lines.en: That's fine. I keep floating.
The tide will carry everything.

lines.zh: 腕足尖把那东西挑了起来。
lines.en: The tip of an arm flicks it up.
It's so small I can barely see it.
I coil it up and raise it to my eye.
I bring it to my eye and look.
I look, then let it down.
I drop it. Worthless.
Too light; I toss it back into the waves.
It makes a small splash.
I settle back onto the surface.

lines.zh: 我照旧漂着，候潮水上涌。
lines.en: I float on, waiting for the tide.
You've stepped into the shallows.
I lift an arm from below the water.
The clouds blacken at once.
Lightning strikes the sea.

lines.zh: 雷电砸在海面上，我才开始挪。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea. Only then do I move.
The water churns under me.

lines.zh: 海水在我底下翻，你奔回岸上。
lines.en: Water churns beneath me. You run for shore.

lines.zh: 你往岸上跑，我看着你跑。
lines.en: You run for the shore. I watch you run.
This sea has no end.

lines.zh: 海没有边，你终究要落到水里。
lines.en: The sea has no edge. You'll end up in it.
You'll be in the water. Sooner or later.

lines.zh: 我又举起腕足，这回是另一条。
lines.en: I raise another arm.
Its shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 巨影把你整个罩住，你停住脚。
lines.en: The shadow covers you entirely. You stop.
You stopped. Yes. Look at me.

lines.zh: 看着我，就这样，我压下来。
lines.en: Look at me. Just so. I bring it down.

lines.zh: 我压下去，海水会兜住你。
lines.en: I bring it down. The sea will hold you.

lines.zh: 海水托着你，我也托着你。
lines.en: The sea holds you. So do I.
You're in the water. You swim well.

lines.zh: 你水性不差，只是海归我。
lines.en: You swim well. The sea is mine.

lines.zh: 整片海都归我，我正贴在你下方。
lines.en: The whole sea is mine, and I’m just below you.

lines.zh: 我伏在你下方，你察觉不到。
lines.en: I lie beneath you, unseen.
My arms spread underwater.

lines.zh: 腕足在水里张开，像一张网。
lines.en: My arms spread underwater, like a net.

lines.zh: 你改道，我的腕足也改向。
lines.en: You change course; my arms change with you.

lines.zh: 你掉头游开，我跟着掉头。
lines.en: You turn away. I turn with you.
Lightning strikes beside you.

lines.zh: 雷电砸在你身侧，海面炸开。
lines.en: Lightning hits beside you. The surface bursts.
You swallow water.
You swim for the rocks.
The rocks are in my reach too.
I coil around the rock.
You're trapped between.
I raise an arm slowly.

lines.zh: 我缓缓举起一条腕足，水位下落。
lines.en: I raise an arm. The water recedes.
The sand under you shows.

lines.zh: 脚下的沙露出来，你无处可去。
lines.en: The sand shows. There's nowhere for you to go.

lines.zh: 我正伏在你看不到的深处。
lines.en: I lie in the depths you can’t see.
One arm sweeps down.

lines.zh: 我一条腕足抽落，海面裂成两半。
lines.en: An arm lashes down and the surface splits.
Another curls in from the side.

lines.zh: 另一条从侧面卷来，你被缠住了。
lines.en: Another curls in. You're caught.

lines.zh: 腕足扣住你，我缓缓收紧。
lines.en: Arms around you. I tighten.

lines.zh: 腕足一收，你的肋骨就响。
lines.en: One squeeze of my arm and your ribs creak.

lines.zh: 你身上骨节作响，我略松了松。
lines.en: Your bones creak. I ease off slightly.
Octopus bombs come down.
You dodge one.

lines.zh: 水面一个接一个炸开，你被掀起来。
lines.en: The surface bursts again and again. You're thrown up.

lines.zh: 你被浪抛起，我托住了你。
lines.en: Thrown up, and I catch you.

lines.zh: 我把你托住，水里反倒稳妥。
lines.en: I hold you. The water is safer.
I raise my head; lightning gathers.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，雷云聚拢，该收了。
lines.en: I lift my head. Lightning gathers. Time to end it.
The sea begins to turn.
The whirlpool widens.
I rise out of it.
Eight arms break the surface first.
My head breaks the surface last.
Water streams off my hide.
The sky darkens further.

lines.zh: 天光又沉下去一层，云里滚雷。
lines.en: The sky darkens another layer, thunder rolling.
Thunder rolls. I look at the shore.
There are living things there.

lines.zh: 我望向岸上，那点东西太小。
lines.en: I look at the shore. So small.
But anything that moves counts.

lines.zh: 我的腕足缠上了岸边的礁石。
lines.en: My arms coil around the shore rocks.
When it falls, the waves rise.
The waves rise. I swim for the shore.
The rocks break beneath me.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，海是黑的。
lines.en: The sea is black where I pass.

lines.zh: 礁石在下面断掉，潮水跟着我。
lines.en: Rocks break beneath me. The tide follows.

lines.zh: 潮水随我而来，从不曾断。
lines.en: The tide comes with me. Always.

lines.zh: 我过处海水发黑，正是时候。
lines.en: The sea blackens where I pass. It's time.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，烧不到我的深处。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface, not deep in me.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，海面被砸开。
lines.en: I fall and the sea splits open.

lines.zh: 我就是海，却也有过窒息。
lines.en: I am the sea, and yet I've felt it choke me.

lines.zh: 爆炸在水下闷响，我被掀动。
lines.en: The blast booms underwater and I'm shaken.

lines.zh: 弹丸打进我的腕足，陷在里面。
lines.en: A round buries in my arm.
Light sets the seawater still.
This sea is empty, and so am I.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning falls on me and I shudder.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，海也被抽干了。
lines.en: I fall, and the sea is drained away.
